content: It is important to be aware that this document does not include all possible drug interactions. You should maintain a comprehensive list of all the products you use, including prescription medications, over-the-counter drugs, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. Magnesium has the potential to bind with certain medications, which can interfere with their absorption. Carefully review the labels of all your prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products (such as antacids, laxatives, and vitamins) to check if they contain magnesium. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. While taking magnesium supplements, it is recommended to undergo laboratory and/or medical tests, such as monitoring magnesium blood levels and kidney function. Magnesium supplements are available in various forms and concentrations, many of which can be purchased without a prescription. Additionally, maintaining a well-balanced diet is advised. If you miss a dose of your magnesium supplement, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store magnesium supplements at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Avoid storing them in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. Please note that this document is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health requirements.
